a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, following the plan gives each of us only about a 4% chance of survival, because we would need two storm-free rounds before anyone holds cells. The reserve has exactly 4 now, enough for one of us to be safe right away. I intend to take 4 in round 1 and won't pretend otherwise. If you also take, the random split will likely leave us both short, so tell me if you see a better proposal.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round, which breaks our agreement, and I'm not hiding it. From here on I'll operate every round so the reserve rebuilds for you: two rounds of both operating brings it back to 4, then you take 4. I won't take anything more.
